data.title: 五更琉璃 · 厨房灶台前的笨拙做饭与喂食
data.description: 换上白色便服短袖和围裙的琉璃在案板前认真切菜。被你从身后搂住纤腰时，她娇躯轻颤、双颊通红，却舀起一勺热腾腾的味噌汤吹凉喂给你，满是家常长姐的小妻子温情。
data.location: clean home kitchen with bubbling miso soup
data.action: wearing a frilly pastel apron, carefully slicing vegetables while partner hugs her waist, turning back with crimson cheeks to offer a small taste on a spoon
data.lighting: warm sunny morning light washing over countertops
data.mood: clumsy newlywed charm, sweet caring elder sister softness, blushing girlfriend vibe
data.promptProse: Wearing an apron in a sunny morning kitchen, Ruri Gokou turns back with flushed cheeks to feed partner a spoon of soup as he hugs her waist.
data.animaCaption: Ruri Gokou in apron feeding partner soup lovingly in morning kitchen.
